summary: Iron Horse Acquisition II Corp. filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its merger agreement with Electra Vehicles, Inc. The amendment revises the Aggregate Merger Consideration, Conversion Ratio, earnout shares, and bridge financing treatment. As a SPAC, IRHO is the issuer filer in a de-SPAC business combination. The board has not disclosed a recommendation change; the registration statement on Form S-4 was filed May 15. No price per share or premium is stated. Watch for shareholder vote timing and redemption risk; the risk-arb angle focuses on IRHO's trust value and potential redemptions ahead of close.
